items.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: I came to New York in Lucky Millinder’s band. 1948. I stayed in Lucky’s band two weeks, I got fired, and then I went back.

ctx.x: A lot of the fellows at that time seemed to also go through Lucky Millinder’s band?

I came to New York in Lucky Millinder’s band. 1948. I stayed in Lucky’s band two weeks, I got fired, and then I went back. Oh, the reason he fired me is ‘cause I had on a pair of black trousers instead of tuxedo pants. So I stayed there about I guess two more months and then, who did I go with then, I think it was Lunceford’s band. They were making a memorial tour. And that was the era where you had to have two tenor saxophones, battling as part of the showmanship. And their band wasn’t set up that way. They had…
